description: GiftRoam lets you send a real gift — curated gift baskets, flowers, wine and treats — to friends, family and colleagues in 190+ countries, right from the chat. Search by destination, occasion and budget; every price is final and includes delivery, assembled by local partners in the destination country. Check realistic delivery dates, then get a secure checkout link where you enter the recipient's address and pay on giftroam.com (Stripe). Track the order afterwards with your order code. No account needed to browse; recipient details and payment never pass through the chat.
